SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 7044
7 11 35

November 8 38.

M. Milikovsky, Esq.,
Vice Consul,
Consulate-General for U.S.S.R.,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter dated October 31, 1938, and to inform
you that there is no house in Whashing Road bearing
the number 168. A scrutiny of the records of the
Revenue Department shows that there is no such address,
and inquiries in the neighbourhood have failed to
disclose any explanation of the error regarding the
number.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

K.M.B.

J.R.S.
00135
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 704.
Special Branch S.2. Section.
REPORT
Date November 5, 1935
Subject Inquiry from Union of Soviet Socialist Republics Consulate
General re house in Washing Road.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by
In connection with the attached inquiry from the U.S.S.R.
Consulate General concerning the owner of a house said to be
situated at 108 Washing Road, I find on visiting the neighbourhood
that there is no house numbered 108 in Washing Road, nor yet any
alleyway bearing this number.
Examination of the books at the S.M.C. Revenue Office
confirms that there is no house with the number 108 in Washing
Road.
D.I. Special Branch D.S.
（签名：D.S. Jones）

UNION OF SOVIET SOCIALIST REPUBLICS
CONSULATE GENERAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
S. U. REGISTRY
Secretariat S.M.C. B. D. 7044
1 NOV. 1935
Received

Shanghai, October 31, 1935.

Shanghai Municipal Council,
209 Kiangse Road,
SHANGHAI.

Sirs,

I shall be much obliged if you will kindly
help me find out the name of the owner of the house
situated at 108 Whashing Road.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I am, Sirs,

Yours faithfully,

A. Milikovsky
Vice-Consul for the U.S.S.R.

MM/JC.

REFERRED TO
POLICE FORCE
FOR THE NECESSARY ACTION DIRECT
1 NOV. 1935
